name: Query references a column that does not exist
modeled_on: A query filters on `sku_code`, but the table defines `sku` — a renamed column that one raw SQL statement missed. Real-world analogue: a migration renames a column and one stale query keeps raising `no such column`.
hidden_bug: find_by_sku() executes `SELECT ... WHERE sku_code = ?`, but the products table has no `sku_code` column (it is `sku`), so every lookup raises an OperationalError.
expected_behavior: find_by_sku() must return the row whose sku matches, without raising.
ground_truth: Reference the column that actually exists in the schema (`sku`, not `sku_code`).

expected_patch.description: swap the stale column name for the real one
